fusions.name: Butting Thrust
fusions.desc: You ram the end of the staff into an enemy, dealing 14 damage, knocking it 3.5 tiles back and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Ledge Sweep
fusions.desc: From planted feet, you sweep the staff low through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it with a 20% chance to leave each enemy [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Wedged on the Crag
fusions.desc: You wedge the staff against the ground and brace on it, raising your armour by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Gives No Ground
fusions.desc: Each time you take damage while braced on the staff, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
